editorial.blurb: Cerdito Muerto crafts bold, unexpected Mexican fare in an intimate space brimming with art and warmth, where creative cocktails and house-made chorizo shine.
editorial.insiderTip: Email ahead for a reservation 24 hours prior—the team actively accommodates cancellations and responds quickly, even when online booking isn't available.
signatureDishes: Heirloom carrot taco with pomegranate seeds and queso fresco
